Machine learning-assisted Zr-MOF(Fe)@SECHA fluorescence and colorimetric 
dual-mode intelligent platform for sensitive LPS detection.

Liang P(1), Zhou W(1), Li J(1), Guo Y(1), Tu J(1), Yang K(1), Ma X(1), Li P(1), 
Ye L(2).

Author information:
(1)Department of Medicine, the Sixth Affiliated Hospital of South China 
University of Technology (Nanhai District People's Hospital of Foshan), Foshan, 
528200, PR China.
(2)Department of Medicine, the Sixth Affiliated Hospital of South China 
University of Technology (Nanhai District People's Hospital of Foshan), Foshan,

BACKGROUND: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) is a crucial diagnosis biomarker for 
sepsis. Accurate and sensitive determination of LPS in real samples (human serum 
and vancomycin) assumes paramount importance in effectively preventing sepsis 
and promoting public health. Regrettably, traditional detection methods often 
suffer from a single signal output, which is insufficient for accurate and 
reliable analysis of LPS in real samples. Therefore, it remains a challenge to 
develop an accurate and sensitive LPS analysis strategy to facilitate early 
diagnosis and drug safety.
RESULTS: The integration of self-feedback exponential catalytic hairpin assembly 
(SECHA) with Zr-MOFFe was proposed (denoted as Zr-MOFFe@SECHA) to achieve 
fluorescence and colorimetric dual-mode for the accurate and sensitive analysis 
of LPS in real samples. The optimally synthesized Zr-MOFFe exhibited 
satisfactory peroxidase activity and enhanced fluorescence quenching efficiency. 
The SECHA system consisted of two hairpin probes (H1 and H2) and two 
double-stranded DNA probes (ST and HP). The rational design endowed the system 
with remarkable exponential amplification efficiency. Both modes exhibited broad 
linear ranges (1 fg mL-1 to 1 ng mL-1 for fluorescence and 5 pg mL-1 to 
5 ng mL-1 for colorimetry) and lower detection limits (0.254 fg mL-1 and 
0.143 pg mL-1, respectively). Finally, with the help of machine learning, the 
backpropagation neural network (BPNN) model could enable intelligent, accurate, 
and sensitive determination of LPS concentration based on fluorescence spectra 
and colorimetric images.
SIGNIFICANCE: The experimental results indicate that the constructed strategy is 
a sensitive and reliable platform for monitoring LPS. It exhibits high
